title: CanvasContentToProcessSummary
description: The response to canvas_content_to_slack. The content is the meeting summary and is never logged or stored. Either a success (ok true) or a failure (ok false). A failed call raises Slack's error code (ratelimited is retried later) and nothing but ok and error is read. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

content.description: The canvas as markdown; may be empty.

error.description: Slack's error code when ok is false, e.g. not_in_channel or ratelimited. A missing or empty code is reported as unknown_error. Never null.
